title: AI替我拉客
summary: 火锅店老板老王跪求顾客无果想烧店，被朋友用AI推广救场，从嘲讽到爆火逆袭，一年后开出第8家分店。

shots.dialogue: 求您了，免费吃！……太脏了，走走走。
shots.positive_prompt: Live-action Chinese street comedy, realistic urban small-city vibe. A chubby 50-year-old hotpot owner in a greasy apron kneels on the pavement at the doorway of his small hotpot restaurant, hands pressed together, repeatedly bowing and kowtowing, mouth open mid-shout, desperate expression. Pedestrians and diners frown, pinch their noses with disgust and quickly sidestep around him, walking out of frame. Slight high-angle shot emphasizing his humbleness and the empty, deserted street. Warm dusk tungsten light, glowing red-and-white shop sign board, greasy smoke haze. Shallow depth of field: subject sharp, background crowd and street softly blurred. Handheld micro-shake, subtle push-in.
